declarations.name: Harsanyi.reconstruct_union_disjoint
declarations.signature:

      (∑ U ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} A, ∑ V ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} B, d (Union.union.{u_1} U V))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_symmetry
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (g : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (S : Finset.{u_1} α) (i j : α),
  i ∉ S →
    j ∉ S →
      (∀ (U : Finset.{u_1} α),
          HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} U S → Eq.{1} (g (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} i U)) (g (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} j U))) →
        Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} g (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} i S))
          (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} g (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} j S))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_context_difference
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (g : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  ∀ i ∉ S,
    Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} g (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} i S))
      (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (fun U => g (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} i U)) S)
        (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} g S))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.interaction_additive_dummy_nonempty
declarations.signature:

      ∀ (c : Real),
        (∀ (U : Finset.{u_1} α),
            HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} U S → Eq.{1} (g (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} i U)) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (g U) c)) →
          Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} g (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} i S)) 0

declarations.name: Harsanyi.factorial_powerset_sum
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (R : Finset.{u_1} α) (a b : Nat),
  Eq.{1}
    (∑ U ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} R,
      HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Nat.factorial (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} a (Finset.card.{u_1} U)))
        ↑(Nat.factorial (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} b (Finset.card.{u_1} R)) (Finset.card.{u_1} U))))
    (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0}
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Nat.factorial a) ↑(Nat.factorial b))
        ↑(Nat.factorial (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} a b) (Finset.card.{u_1} R)) 1)))
      ↑(Nat.factorial (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} a b) 1)))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.sum_supersets_eq_sum_complement
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (N L : Finset.{u_1} α),
  HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} L N →
    ∀ (f : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α),
      Eq.{1} (∑ S ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} N, ite.{1} (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} L S) (f S) 0)
        (∑ U ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} (SDiff.sdiff.{u_1} N L), f (Union.union.{u_1} L U))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.factorialWeight

declarations.name: Harsanyi.factorialWeight_superset_sum
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (k : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} 0 k →
    ∀ (N L : Finset.{u_1} α),
      HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} L N →
        Eq.{1}
          (∑ S ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} N,
            ite.{1} (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} L S)
              (Harsanyi.factorialWeight k (Finset.card.{u_1} N) (Finset.card.{u_1} S)) 0)
          (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Nat.factorial (Finset.card.{u_1} L)) ↑(Nat.factorial k))
            ↑(Nat.factorial (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Finset.card.{u_1} L) k)))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.sum_powerset_extend
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (N S : Finset.{u_1} α),
  HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} S N →
    ∀ (d : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α),
      Eq.{1} (∑ U ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} S, d U)
        (∑ U ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} N, ite.{1} (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} U S) (d U) 0)

declarations.name: Harsanyi.weighted_higherMarginal_eq
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (g : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (T N : Finset.{u_1} α),
  Disjoint.{u_1} T N →
    ∀ (k : Nat),
      LT.lt.{0} 0 k →
        Eq.{1}
          (∑ S ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} N,
            HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Harsanyi.factorialWeight k (Finset.card.{u_1} N) (Finset.card.{u_1} S))
              (Harsanyi.higherMarginal.{u_1} g T S))
          (∑ U ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} N,
            HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
              (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Nat.factorial (Finset.card.{u_1} U)) ↑(Nat.factorial k))
                ↑(Nat.factorial (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Finset.card.{u_1} U) k)))
              (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} g (Union.union.{u_1} T U)))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.factorial_ratio_eq_choose_inv
declarations.signature:
∀ (a k : Nat),
  Eq.{1}
    (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Nat.factorial a) ↑(Nat.factorial k))
      ↑(Nat.factorial (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} a k)))
    (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} 1 ↑(Nat.choose (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} a k) k))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.factorialWeight_one
declarations.signature:
∀ (m s : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.factorialWeight 1 m s)
    (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Nat.factorial s) ↑(Nat.factorial (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} m s)))
      ↑(Nat.factorial (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} m 1)))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.factorialWeight_eq_inv_choose
declarations.signature:
∀ (k m s : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} 0 k →
    LE.le.{0} s m →
      Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.factorialWeight k m s)
        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (↑k) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} ↑m ↑k))
          (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} 1 ↑(Nat.choose (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} m k) 1) s)))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.factorialShapley_eq_dividends
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (g : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (N : Finset.{u_1} α) (i : α),
  Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} N i →
    Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.factorialShapley.{u_1} g N i)
      (∑ S ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} (Finset.erase.{u_1} N i),

  HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} T N →
    Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.factorialShapleyInteraction.{u_1} g N T)
      (∑ S ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} (SDiff.sdiff.{u_1} N T),
        HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} 1 (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (↑(Finset.card.{u_1} S)) 1))

declarations.name: Harsanyi.shapleyTaylor_eq_dividends
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] (g : Harsanyi.Game.{u_1} α) (N T : Finset.{u_1} α),
  HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} T N →
    ∀ (k : Nat),
      LT.lt.{0} 0 k →
        Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.shapleyTaylor.{u_1} g N k T)
          (ite.{1} (LT.lt.{0} (Finset.card.{u_1} T) k) (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} g T)
            (ite.{1} (Eq.{1} (Finset.card.{u_1} T) k)
              (∑ S ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} (SDiff.sdiff.{u_1} N T),
                HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                  (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} 1 ↑(Nat.choose (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Finset.card.{u_1} S) k) k))
                  (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} g (Union.union.{u_1} T S)))
              0))
